name: AWS Vicksburg data center campus
aliases: AWS Warren County data center campus
summary: Amazon announced in November 2025 that it would spend at least $3 billion on a new data center campus in Vicksburg, Warren County, with at least 200 full-time jobs. Officials said construction would start in 2026 and the local mayor expected a five-to-seven-year build-out. Amazon said the campus will support AI and cloud computing. Entergy Mississippi agreed to meet its long-term power needs and is building a gas plant at the former Baxter Wilson site to serve the campus and other industrial projects. The April 2026 statewide update still listed it as planned.

location.note: No site, parcel or road has been published; coordinates are the Vicksburg city point from its Wikipedia article (Nominatim was unavailable).

parties.name: Warren County
parties.note: The county is contributing to the project; state incentives passed for the Madison County campuses also apply.

metrics.note: Officials also project more than 300 additional positions in the wider county.

milestones.note: Target year given at announcement; no source opened confirms that work has begun.

power_sources.description: Entergy Mississippi committed to the campus's long-term power needs and is building a roughly $1.2 billion gas-fired station at the retired Baxter Wilson plant site to serve this and other industrial load.
